project.description: Shared model, text codec and crypto helpers used by both the client (license-client) and the issuer (license-issuer), so the two sides of the wire format cannot silently drift apart. Deliberately has zero external dependencies beyond the JDK - everything, including JSON encoding, is hand-rolled in this module - so the whole project can be built with nothing but a JDK 21 and Maven's own core plugins, and so the signed payload format has no external parsing dependency that could change behavior out from under an already-deployed signature scheme.
